title: On Data Engineering for Scaling LLM Terminal Capabilities
authors_zh: Renjie Pi、Grace Lam、Mohammad Shoeybi、Pooya Jannaty、Bryan Catanzaro、Wei Ping
paper_type_zh: 终端 agent 轨迹数据发布、构建配方与规模研究
best_for_zh: 关注终端 agent SFT、rollout/失败轨迹、程序化验证、容器环境与开放数据审计的研究者
one_line: Releases exactly 366,154 train-only terminal SFT episodes from dataset adapters and skill-based synthesis, while the paper's no-filter recipe retains incomplete and failed behavior but the public rows expose no normalized outcome or reward.
公开 366,154 条 train-only 终端 SFT episode；论文研究的完整混合共 490,520 条，其中 124,366 条 seed-based 轨迹尚未确认发布，且公开行没有规范化 outcome、reward 或 test result。
why: It provides unusually direct evidence that retaining realistic error states can outperform success-only filtering for terminal-agent SFT, while making count reconciliation, failure labels, verifier semantics, and container replayability first-class audit requirements.
inclusion_reason: This work releases a large terminal SFT corpus and a concrete no-filter trajectory recipe whose action-observation episodes, failure retention, data-scale ablations, and release/replay gaps directly expose how rollout data affects terminal-agent post-training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Terminal agents need supervision that couples reasoning and shell actions to the changing state of an executable environment. Such data is expensive to collect: every episode may require a fresh container, multi-turn interaction, dependency installation, command execution, and an end-state check. Existing terminal-agent reports rarely disclose enough about task sources, unsuccessful attempts, environment construction, or filtering to determine what actually entered training.

This work addresses two linked gaps. The construction gap is how to obtain both broad coverage and terminal-specific tasks without relying on scarce human interaction logs. The audit gap is how to distinguish a paper's experimental mixture from the rows that are actually downloadable, and how to interpret a retained trajectory when the release does not expose a normalized verifier result. Those distinctions matter here because the paper studies 490,520 trajectories, whereas the confirmed public corpus has 366,154 rows, and because the paper supports retaining incomplete and unsuccessful behavior while the released row schema does not make those outcome classes directly enumerable.

终端 agent 的监督数据需要把推理与 shell 操作同可执行环境中不断变化的状态连接起来。这类数据采集成本高：一个 episode 可能需要新建容器、多轮交互、安装依赖、执行命令并检查最终状态。现有终端 agent 报告往往没有充分披露任务来源、未成功尝试、环境构建方式或过滤过程，因此难以判断真正进入训练的对象。

本文处理两个相互关联的缺口。构建层面的问题是：在缺少人类交互日志的情况下，如何同时获得广覆盖与终端专用任务。审计层面的问题是：如何区分论文实验使用的数据混合与实际可下载的行，以及当发布物没有规范化 verifier result 时应怎样解释“被保留”的轨迹。这里必须保持这些边界，因为论文研究了 490,520 条轨迹，而已确认公开的 corpus 只有 366,154 行；论文证据支持保留 incomplete 和 unsuccessful 行为，但公开行 schema 无法直接枚举这些 outcome 类别。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper combines two task-sourcing strategies in Terminal-Task-Gen. Dataset adaptation wraps existing math, code, and software-engineering prompts in the Terminus 2 terminal interface. Synthetic generation either transforms structured seeds into adjacent terminal tasks or combines typically three to five primitive skills to target terminal-specific capabilities. DeepSeek-V3.2 generates the synthetic tasks and all SFT trajectories; Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-32B are the student bases.

The reusable data object is a full terminal episode serialized as conversations role/content cells plus coarse agent, model, model_provider, date, task, episode, run_id, trial_name, and enable_thinking metadata. Adapter configurations also expose source. Assistant content includes analysis or plan text and a Terminus 2 action object whose commands contain literal keystrokes and wait duration; user turns carry the current screen or New Terminal Output. The final artifact is task-dependent environment state, files, code, patches, or reports rather than a uniform answer string.

The public Nemotron-Terminal-Corpus contains exactly 366,154 train-only rows: 226,313 adapter rows and 139,841 skill-based rows, the latter split into 44,809 easy, 89,343 medium, and 5,689 mixed rows. Paper Table 5 instead totals 490,520 trajectories by adding 124,366 seed-based trajectories. No confirmed public artifact contains that seed-based stream. The release is therefore a substantial but incomplete projection of the paper's studied mixture, not a downloadable copy of all 490,520 trajectories.

Terminal-Task-Gen 联合两种任务来源策略。Dataset adaptation 把已有的数学、代码与软件工程 prompt 包装进 Terminus 2 终端接口。Synthetic generation 要么把结构化 seed 改写为相邻的终端任务，要么组合通常三到五项 primitive skills，以定向覆盖终端专用能力。DeepSeek-V3.2 生成 synthetic tasks 以及全部 SFT trajectories；学生模型从 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B 和 Qwen3-32B 初始化。

可复用的数据对象是完整终端 episode：它以 conversations 的 role/content 单元序列化，并附带较粗粒度的 agent、model、model_provider、date、task、episode、run_id、trial_name 与 enable_thinking 元数据；adapter 配置还公开 source。assistant 内容包括 analysis/plan 文本和 Terminus 2 action object，其中 commands 保存字面 keystrokes 与等待 duration；user 轮次承载当前屏幕或 New Terminal Output。最终产物依任务而异，可能是环境状态、文件、代码、patch 或报告，而不是统一的答案字符串。

公开的 Nemotron-Terminal-Corpus 恰有 366,154 条 train-only 记录：226,313 条 adapter 记录与 139,841 条 skill-based 记录，后者又分为 44,809 条 easy、89,343 条 medium 和 5,689 条 mixed。论文 Table 5 还包括 124,366 条 seed-based 轨迹，总计 490,520 条；目前没有已确认公开 artifact 包含这部分 seed-based stream。因此，发布物是论文研究混合的一个规模较大但不完整的投影，并非全部 490,520 条轨迹的可下载副本。

title: Method
方法
html:
For dataset adaptation, the pipeline draws filtered prompts from Nemotron-Cascade math, code, and SWE mixtures derived from OpenMathReasoning, OpenCodeReasoning, SWE-Bench-Train, SWE-reBench, SWE-Smith, and SWE-Fixer-Train. It inserts the original prompt and a domain-specific suffix into the Terminus 2 template; SWE code files are instantiated in the environment. These adapter tasks have an instruction and environment but no associated tests, so their correctness contract is not uniformly programmatic.

Synthetic generation has seed-based and skill-based branches. The skill branch typically combines three to five items from a domain taxonomy spanning data processing, data querying, data science, debugging, dependency management, file operations, scientific computing, security, software engineering, and related categories present in the release. A synthetic task specification includes a natural-language instruction, optional input files, task.toml, an environment/Dockerfile, and pytest-based tests; checked archives contain empty solution/ directories rather than generated oracle solutions. Nine shared domain images are described, but they are not bound to immutable digests.

DeepSeek-V3.2 operates through Terminus 2 in Docker/tmux. At each turn, the scaffold supplies the current terminal state and requests structured JSON actions; literal keystrokes are executed and the resulting terminal output becomes the next observation. Harbor coordinates generation, with an author extension for Singularity/HPC, while Daytona is used for evaluation. Teacher temperature, seeds, turn/token/time limits, retries, attempts per task, serving snapshot, and generation compute remain unknown.

For checked synthetic infrastructure, pytest evaluates the end state and a representative tests/test.sh writes binary 1 or 0 to /logs/verifier/reward.txt from the pytest exit status. Task specifications can assign partial-credit weights to individual tests, but the public conversation corpus has no normalized outcome, scalar reward, test result, termination cause, or verifier-log column. The assistant's embedded task_complete is self-declared and is not the terminal predicate. Adapter tasks have no tests.

Post-processing removes prompts with a 14-gram overlap against Terminal-Bench 2.0 test prompts, identity leaks, and responses containing Chinese characters. The selected recipe otherwise keeps decontaminated trajectories regardless of teacher-declared completion or test success. Student SFT uses veRL and AdamW for two epochs with learning rate 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, global batch size 128, micro-batch size 1 per GPU, cosine scheduling, 10% warmup, gradient clipping 1.0, and CPU offload. The default maximum SFT length is 32,768 tokens; longer-context and curriculum variants are ablations rather than separate released row manifests.

Dataset adaptation 从 Nemotron-Cascade 的数学、代码和 SWE 混合中选取经过过滤的 prompt；这些混合源自 OpenMathReasoning、OpenCodeReasoning、SWE-Bench-Train、SWE-reBench、SWE-Smith 与 SWE-Fixer-Train。流水线把原 prompt 和领域后缀插入 Terminus 2 模板，并在环境中实例化 SWE 代码文件。这些 adapter tasks 只有 instruction 与 environment，没有关联 tests，因此其 correctness contract 不能统一视为 programmatic。

Synthetic generation 分为 seed-based 与 skill-based 两条支路。skill 支路通常从一套领域 taxonomy 中组合三到五项技能，覆盖 data processing、data querying、data science、debugging、dependency management、file operations、scientific computing、security、software engineering，以及发布目录中的相关类别。一个 synthetic task specification 包含自然语言 instruction、可选 input files、task.toml、environment/Dockerfile 和基于 pytest 的 tests；已检查的 archive 中 solution/ 目录为空，没有生成的 oracle solution。论文描述了九个共享领域镜像，但没有用不可变 digest 绑定它们。

DeepSeek-V3.2 通过 Docker/tmux 中的 Terminus 2 工作。每轮 scaffold 提供当前终端状态并要求结构化 JSON action；系统执行字面 keystrokes，再把终端输出作为下一轮 observation。Harbor 负责生成编排，作者扩展支持 Singularity/HPC；Daytona 用于评测。teacher 的 temperature、seed、turn/token/time 上限、retry、每任务 attempts、服务快照与生成计算量均为 unknown。

在已检查的 synthetic infrastructure 中，pytest 检查最终状态；一个代表性的 tests/test.sh 根据 pytest 退出状态把二值 1 或 0 写入 /logs/verifier/reward.txt。任务 specification 可为单项测试配置 partial-credit 权重，但公开 conversation corpus 没有规范化 outcome、scalar reward、test result、termination cause 或 verifier log 列。assistant 内嵌的 task_complete 只是自我声明，不是 terminal predicate；adapter tasks 则没有 tests。

Post-processing 删除与 Terminal-Bench 2.0 test prompts 存在 14-gram 重叠的 prompt、identity leak，以及包含中文字符的 response。除此之外，最终配方会保留通过去重与质量过滤的轨迹，不依据 teacher-declared completion 或 test success 再筛除。学生 SFT 使用 veRL 与 AdamW，训练两轮，learning rate 为 2e-5、weight decay 为 1e-4、global batch size 为 128、每 GPU micro-batch size 为 1，并采用 cosine schedule、10% warmup、gradient clipping 1.0 和 CPU offload。默认 SFT 最大长度为 32,768 tokens；long-context 与 curriculum 设置只是消融实验，没有对应的独立公开行 manifest。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The release evidence and the paper evidence answer different questions. The current official Nemotron-Terminal-Corpus exposes four train-only configurations totaling exactly 366,154 rows: 226,313 dataset_adapters, 44,809 skill_based_easy, 89,343 skill_based_medium, and 5,689 skill_based_mixed. Their sum reconciles to the paper's 226,313 adapter and 139,841 skill-based trajectories. It does not reconcile to the full Table 5 total of 490,520 because the paper also uses 124,366 seed-based trajectories that are not confirmed in the public collection. The schema confirms conversations and run metadata, but no normalized success, reward, test-result, or termination field.

The filtering ablations provide evidence for the study recipe. For adapter data, the paper compares 196,940 complete-only samples with 226,313 no-filter samples and selects no filtering. For the full synthetic mixture, Table 7 compares complete-only (104,603 samples, 6.74 ± 2.20 on Terminal-Bench 2.0), success-only (83,448, 5.06 ± 2.11), and no filter (264,207, 12.4 ± 2.29). Under this experiment, the no-filter mixture performs better, consistent with the authors' interpretation that error states and recovery behavior can supply useful supervision.

That result does not establish the label composition of the public 366,154 rows. Table 7 covers both seed-based and skill-based synthetic trajectories, including the missing 124,366-row stream. The released feature map does not expose the completion and test-success labels needed to reproduce the complete/success/failure breakdown. It is therefore evidence that the paper's selected training recipe retains unsuccessful and incomplete behavior, not evidence that every released row has a verified outcome or that a reuser can select failures by label.

The remaining reported experiments show associations under the paper's SFT setup: single-stage mixed training outperforms the tested adapter-then-synthetic curriculum; Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B improve as the synthetic-data fraction rises through 0%, 1%, 2%, 5%, 10%, and 100%; and the default 32,768-token SFT with 40,960-token evaluation performs better than the reported 65,536-token variants. Nemotron-Terminal models also improve over their Qwen3 bases on Terminal-Bench 2.0. These benchmark results support the tested recipe's utility, but they do not by themselves prove corpus correctness, verifier quality, absence of contamination, or exact replayability.

发布物证据与论文证据回答的是不同问题。当前官方 Nemotron-Terminal-Corpus 有四个 train-only 配置，合计恰好 366,154 行：226,313 条 dataset_adapters、44,809 条 skill_based_easy、89,343 条 skill_based_medium 与 5,689 条 skill_based_mixed。这些数与论文中的 226,313 条 adapter 和 139,841 条 skill-based 轨迹完全对齐，但无法对齐 Table 5 的 490,520 条总数，因为论文还使用了 124,366 条未在公开 collection 中确认的 seed-based 轨迹。公开 schema 证实存在 conversation 与 run 元数据，但没有规范化 success、reward、test result 或 termination 字段。

过滤消融为论文所选配方提供了证据。对 adapter 数据，论文比较 196,940 条 complete-only 样本与 226,313 条 no-filter 样本，并选择不按完成状态过滤。对完整 synthetic mixture，Table 7 比较 complete-only（104,603 条，Terminal-Bench 2.0 为 6.74 ± 2.20）、success-only（83,448 条，5.06 ± 2.11）与 no filter（264,207 条，12.4 ± 2.29）。在该实验中，no-filter mixture 表现更好，这与作者关于 error state 和 recovery behavior 可提供有用监督的解释一致。

这一结果不能确定公开 366,154 行的标签构成。Table 7 同时覆盖 seed-based 与 skill-based synthetic 轨迹，其中包括缺失的 124,366 条 stream。公开 feature map 没有复现 complete/success/failure 划分所需的 completion 与 test-success 标签。因此，证据支持“论文所选训练配方保留 unsuccessful 和 incomplete 行为”，但不支持“每条公开记录都有已验证 outcome”，复用者也不能按公开标签直接选出失败轨迹。

其余实验展示的是论文 SFT 设置下的关联：单阶段 mixed training 优于所测的 adapter-then-synthetic curriculum；Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-14B 的表现随 synthetic-data fraction 从 0%、1%、2%、5%、10% 增至 100% 而提高；默认 32,768-token SFT 配合 40,960-token evaluation 优于论文报告的 65,536-token 变体。Nemotron-Terminal 模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上也优于各自的 Qwen3 base。这些 benchmark 结果支持所测配方的效用，但不能单独证明 corpus correctness、verifier quality、无污染或 exact replayability。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not merely another terminal benchmark result. Terminal-Task-Gen puts broad prompt adaptation and targeted executable synthesis in one construction pipeline, then studies data filtering, mixture order, context length, and scale with the same family of student models. The episode representation preserves multi-turn commands, observations, corrections, and recovery behavior rather than reducing an attempt to a final answer.

The most consequential empirical distinction is the explicit comparison of no-filter, completion-filtered, and success-filtered SFT mixtures. In the tested setting, discarding incomplete and unsuccessful trajectories removes much of the data and performs worse. This turns negative and partial behavior into a concrete data-engineering variable rather than an unreported by-product of rollout generation.

The open artifacts also create an unusually inspectable boundary between task specification, environment, verifier, conversation trace, and trained checkpoint. That boundary is incomplete: task archives are separate from the conversation rows, outcomes are not normalized, and the seed-based stream is missing. The useful novelty is therefore the combined construction-and-ablation surface, not a claim that the release provides fully labeled failures or fully reproducible containers.

本文的贡献不只是又一个终端 benchmark 结果。Terminal-Task-Gen 把广覆盖的 prompt adaptation 与定向、可执行的 synthetic generation 放进同一构建流水线，并在同一学生模型族上研究数据过滤、混合顺序、context length 和 scale。episode 表示保留多轮 command、observation、correction 与 recovery behavior，而不是把一次尝试压缩成最终答案。

最关键的实验区别是显式比较 no-filter、按 completion 过滤和按 success 过滤的 SFT mixture。在所测设置中，丢弃 incomplete 与 unsuccessful 轨迹会去掉大量数据，且表现更差。由此，negative 和 partial behavior 被当作具体的数据工程变量，而非 rollout generation 中未报告的副产物。

开放 artifact 还形成了较可检查的 task specification、environment、verifier、conversation trace 与 trained checkpoint 边界。但这条边界并不完整：task archive 与 conversation rows 分开，outcome 没有规范化，seed-based stream 也未发布。因而真正有用的新意是构建流程与消融分析的组合，而不是宣称发布物提供了完整标注的失败或完全可复现的容器。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Release completeness is the first limitation. The public 366,154 rows equal the adapter and skill-based portions of Table 5, but the 124,366 seed-based trajectories needed to reach the paper total of 490,520 are not confirmed released. None of these row counts is a verified count of unique tasks: the schema separately exposes task, episode, and run identifiers, and task-to-episode multiplicity is unknown. All four public configurations are train-only; scaling-fraction row IDs, curriculum-stage membership, and a conventional validation split are absent.

Outcome semantics are incomplete. The corpus stores actions and observations inside conversation text but has no normalized verifier outcome, reward, test result, failure class, or termination cause. Self-declared task_complete must not be substituted for verifier success. Adapter tasks have no tests. For synthetic tasks, representative pytest infrastructure establishes that binary end-state checking exists, but it does not show that every test suite is semantically complete, resistant to shortcut solutions, or free of false positives and false negatives. The paper's no-filter result is label-level evidence for its experiment, not a release-level failure ledger.

Exact replay is not established. The task archive provides instructions, inputs, task.toml, Dockerfiles, and tests, but representative files reference a mutable internal :latest image, a mutable GHCR :latest base, and unpinned apt/pip installs. Image digests, dependency locks, Harbor/Terminus/Singularity revisions, teacher serving snapshot, seeds, network policy, reset/cache/volume/cleanup rules, and original verifier logs are missing. An internal NVIDIA registry reference may be inaccessible to external reusers. A checked task.toml exposes 900-second agent and verifier timeouts, a 600-second build timeout, 1 CPU, and 2G memory, but that is representative evidence rather than a corpus-wide budget distribution.

The 14-gram Terminal-Bench 2.0 screen is narrower than a general contamination audit. Its normalization, implementation, removal count, and overlap checks against other terminal, math, code, and SWE benchmarks are unknown. Because tests and tasks are public, post-release benchmark contamination also needs separate handling. Coarse adapter source labels and repository-level task/corpus labels do not supply immutable upstream record IDs, prompt transformations, verifier decisions, rejected-item ledgers, or complete lineage.

Both official dataset repositories are labeled CC BY 4.0, but that label does not reconcile record-level rights and attribution for upstream prompts, issues or patches, generated traces, model terms, Docker images, packages, and task assets. Privacy, consent, deletion, and withdrawal procedures are unknown. Security tasks can include exploit payloads, vulnerability analysis, authentication, and network operations; Docker isolation is described, but egress, credentials, malicious-output handling, and corpus-wide safety review are not.

Finally, teacher decoding settings, retry counts, generation compute, and Terminal-Task-Gen or training code are not confirmed released. A nontrivial long tail is truncated at the SFT context boundary without per-row truncation metadata. Domain names also drift between the main text, appendix, and public directories. These gaps justify partial status and medium confidence despite verified paper and artifact links.

首先是发布完整性。公开的 366,154 行等于 Table 5 的 adapter 与 skill-based 部分，但达到论文 490,520 条总数所需的 124,366 条 seed-based 轨迹尚未确认发布。这些行数都不是已验证的唯一任务数：schema 分别公开 task、episode 与 run 标识，而一个 task 对应多少 episode 仍为 unknown。四个公开配置都只有 train split；用于 scale 实验的 row ID、curriculum stage membership 与常规 validation split 均缺失。

Outcome 语义不完整。corpus 把 action 与 observation 保存在 conversation 文本中，却没有规范化 verifier outcome、reward、test result、failure class 或 termination cause。不能用模型自报的 task_complete 替代 verifier success。adapter tasks 没有 tests。对 synthetic tasks，代表性的 pytest infrastructure 能证明存在二值 end-state checking，但不能证明每个 test suite 在语义上完整、能抵抗 shortcut solution，或不存在 false positive/false negative。论文的 no-filter 结果是其实验使用标签的证据，不是发布物层面的 failure ledger。

Exact replay 尚未成立。task archive 提供 instruction、input、task.toml、Dockerfile 与 tests，但代表性文件引用可变的内部 :latest image、可变的 GHCR :latest base，以及未锁定版本的 apt/pip 安装。image digest、dependency lock、Harbor/Terminus/Singularity revision、teacher serving snapshot、seed、network policy、reset/cache/volume/cleanup 规则和原始 verifier log 均缺失；内部 NVIDIA registry 引用对外部复用者也可能不可访问。已检查的一个 task.toml 给出 agent/verifier 各 900 秒、build 600 秒、1 CPU 与 2G memory，但这只是代表性证据，不是整个 corpus 的 budget 分布。

针对 Terminal-Bench 2.0 的 14-gram 筛查比通用 contamination audit 更窄。匹配 normalization、实现代码、删除数量，以及对其他 terminal、math、code 与 SWE benchmark 的重叠检查均为 unknown。任务与 tests 公开后产生的 post-release benchmark contamination 也需单独处理。较粗的 adapter source 标签以及 repository-level task/corpus 标签不能提供不可变 upstream record ID、prompt transformation、verifier decision、rejected-item ledger 或完整 lineage。

两个官方 dataset repository 都标为 CC BY 4.0，但该标签没有逐记录协调 upstream prompt、issue 或 patch、generated trace、model terms、Docker image、package 与 task asset 的权利和署名。privacy、consent、deletion 与 withdrawal 流程均为 unknown。security tasks 可能包含 exploit payload、vulnerability analysis、authentication 和 network operation；论文描述了 Docker isolation，却未披露 egress、credential、malicious-output handling 或 corpus-wide safety review。

最后，teacher decoding 设置、retry 次数、generation compute，以及 Terminal-Task-Gen 或训练代码都没有确认发布。SFT context boundary 会截断一个不可忽略的长尾，但没有逐行 truncation 元数据。主文、附录与公开目录之间的领域名称也存在漂移。即使 paper 与 artifact 链接已经核实，这些缺口仍要求保持 partial 状态与中等置信度。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data track, this work is useful because the released unit is a multi-turn action-observation episode rather than only a prompt and final answer. Researchers can study command choice, terminal feedback, correction, recovery, task/run multiplicity, context-length pressure, and the effects of mixing broad adapter traces with targeted skill-based traces. The paper directly tests whether retaining all attempted behavior can be preferable to selecting only complete or successful trajectories.

The demonstrated training use is supervised fine-tuning and terminal-agent training for Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-32B students. The data may support behavior cloning, trajectory distillation, interface modeling, and controlled studies of source mixture or context length, but RLVR is future work in the paper and should not be attributed as a demonstrated use. Failure-conditioned training also requires new labeling: the public rows cannot be reliably partitioned into successful, incomplete, and failed episodes from the published schema alone.

A careful reuse pipeline should pin the corpus and task revisions, retain task, episode, and run_id rather than treating rows as unique tasks, and separate adapter from skill-based configurations. It should recover or regenerate trustworthy outcome labels by executing pinned tests where available, keep self-declared completion separate from verifier success, and document what happens to adapter episodes without tests. Researchers should publish the exact row manifest for any subset or curriculum and record truncation decisions.

Replay-oriented work should replace mutable image tags with digests, lock packages, record harness and scaffold commits, specify network/reset/cache rules, and preserve verifier logs and task budgets. Auditors should extend decontamination beyond the disclosed TB2 14-gram screen, reconcile record-level sources and rights, and review security-task handling. Until the 124,366 seed-based stream and complete pipeline are released, comparisons should state whether they use the 366,154-row public corpus or the 490,520-trajectory paper mixture.

对 Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data track 而言，本文的价值在于公开单元是多轮 action-observation episode，而不只是 prompt 与 final answer。研究者可分析 command choice、terminal feedback、correction、recovery、task/run multiplicity、context-length pressure，以及 broad adapter trace 与 targeted skill-based trace 混合后的影响。论文还直接检验了“保留全部尝试行为”是否优于“只选择 complete 或 successful trajectory”。

已被论文实际验证的训练用途是面向 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B 与 Qwen3-32B 学生模型的 supervised fine-tuning 和 terminal-agent training。数据还可用于 behavior cloning、trajectory distillation、interface modeling，以及 source mixture 或 context length 的受控研究；但 RLVR 在论文中仍是未来工作，不能写成已经展示的用途。failure-conditioned training 也需要新增标签，因为仅凭公开 schema 无法可靠地把记录划分为 successful、incomplete 与 failed episode。

严谨的复用流程应固定 corpus 与 task revision，保留 task、episode 和 run_id，而不是把每行当成唯一 task，并将 adapter 与 skill-based 配置分开。对于有 tests 的任务，应通过执行已固定版本的 tests 来恢复或重新生成可信 outcome label；模型自报 completion 与 verifier success 必须分开，并应说明怎样处理没有 tests 的 adapter episode。任何 subset 或 curriculum 都应发布精确 row manifest，并记录 truncation 决策。

面向 replay 的工作应把可变 image tag 替换为 digest，锁定 package，记录 harness 与 scaffold commit，说明 network/reset/cache 规则，并保存 verifier log 与 task budget。审计还应扩展到已披露 TB2 14-gram 筛查之外的 decontamination，逐记录协调 source 与 rights，并检查 security-task handling。在 124,366 条 seed-based stream 与完整流水线公开之前，任何比较都应明确使用的是 366,154 行公开 corpus，还是论文中的 490,520 条 trajectory mixture。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the public 366,154 rows separate from the paper's 490,520-trajectory mixture; the missing difference is 124,366 seed-based trajectories.
  • Read conversations as embedded action-observation text, not as a normalized outcome schema; task_complete is self-declared.
  • Treat verification as mixed: checked synthetic tasks use pytest-based end-state checks, while adapter tasks have no tests.
  • Interpret the no-filter ablation as evidence for the paper's SFT recipe, not as a label-verifiable failure breakdown of the public release.
  • Before replay or reuse, pin images, dependencies, harness revisions, row manifests, verifier logs, decontamination rules, and component licenses.

• 区分公开的 366,154 行与论文 490,520 条 trajectory mixture；相差的 124,366 条是未确认发布的 seed-based 轨迹。
  • 把 conversations 理解为嵌入文本的 action-observation，而非规范化 outcome schema；task_complete 只是模型自报。
  • 将 verification 视为 mixed：已检查的 synthetic tasks 使用 pytest end-state checks，adapter tasks 则没有 tests。
  • no-filter 消融支持的是论文所选 SFT 配方，不是公开发布物中可按标签核验的 failure breakdown。
  • replay 或复用前应固定 image、dependency、harness revision、row manifest、verifier log、decontamination rule 与组件 license。
